tasks.title: Write an Email
tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt: You recently rented a car for a weekend trip with your dorm mate and were satisfied with the vehicle's performance. However, you had a bad experience with the customer service at the rental office. You want to provide feedback to the rental company manager, Ms. Turner. Write an email to Ms. Turner.
bullets: Explain what features of the car you liked most.
Describe the issues that occurred during your customer service experience.
Suggest ways to improve the pick-up and drop-off process.
tasks.subject: Feedback on Car Rental Experience
